description: The OpenMaya module contains core classes for interacting with Maya.
Default constructor. Returns a new MAngle with a value of 0.0 radians.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MArgList object.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty bounding box with, with both corners set to (0, 0, 0).
The MCallbackIdArray class provides an array of MCallbackId elements using a common array interface and value semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new MColor with red, blue and green set to 0.0 and alpha set to 1.0.
The MColorArray class provides an array of MColor elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MDagPath object.
The MDagPathArray class provides an array of MDagPath elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new MDGContext object using the default context.
Default constructor. Returns a new MDistance with a value of 0.0 centimeters.
The MDoubleArray class provides an array of double-precision float elements using a common array interface and value semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new MEulerRotation object, initialized to the identity rotation.
The MFloatArray class provides an array of single-precision Float elements using a common array interface and value semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new matrix set to the identity matrix.
Default constructor. Returns a new MFloatPoint object, initialized to the origin.
The MFloatPointArray class provides an array of MFloatPoint elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new MFloatVector object initialized to the zero vector.
The MFloatVectorArray class provides an array of MFloatVector elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
The MFn class contains nothing except constants, of which there are too many to list here. See the documentation of MFn in the C++ API for the full list.
Base class for data function sets.
MGlobal is currently a stub which only implements a small portion of the class's total functionality.
The MIntArray class provides an array of integer elements using a common array interface and value semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new matrix set to the identity matrix.
MMeshIsectAccelParams is a wrapper for carrying mesh intersection acceleration parameters between various API methods. There is no external user interface.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MMeshSmoothOptions object.
Returns a new MNodeClass object which will operate on the named node class.
Default constructor. Returns an empty MObject instance (i.e. one which contains kNullObj).
The MObjectArray class provides an array of MObject elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MPlug object.
The MPlugArray class provides an array of MPlug elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new MPoint object, initialized to the origin.
The MPointArray class provides an array of MPoint elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MPxCommand object.
Default constructor. Returns a new MQuaternion object, initialized to the multiplicative identity.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MRampAttribute object.
MSelectionList is currently a stub which only implements a small portion of the class's total functionality.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MSyntax object.
Default constructor. Returns a new MTime object with value 1.0 and unit set to the current UI unit.
Default constructor. Returns a new MTransformationMatrix object, set to the identity transformation.
Default constructor. Returns a new, empty MTypeId object.
The MUint64Array class provides an array of unsigned long integer (64-bit) elements using a common array interface and value semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
The MUintArray class provides an array of unsigned integer elements using a common array interface and value semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new MVector object initialized to the zero vector.
The MVectorArray class provides an array of MVector elements using a common array interface and reference semantics. See Working with M*Array Classes for more details.
Default constructor. Returns a new MWeight object with influence weight of 1 and seam weight of 0.
The OpenMayaAnim module contains classes relating to animation.
The OpenMayaRender module contains classes relating to rendering.
The OpenMayaUI module contains classes relating to interactions with Maya's UI.
